notes.title: 3.1 Release
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42621975/3ddb3fe235ed7f23c5141e86ceb5c6d6e5094788.png"]

Small QoL update to make configuring the game easier.

The settings menu is now cleaner

Added an extremely distracting rainbow theme

Added resolution settings

Previously, the game always rendered at full resolution and downscaled from there according to your window size. There are now proper resolution settings.

Fixed a visual glitch relating to the Frog.
